column1: # Release codenames follow The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy.
# Format: <version-glob><TAB><codename>. '#' and blank lines are ignored.
# The first column is a glob matched against the release version, so a whole
# series can share one name (e.g. 0.9.* covers 0.9.1, 0.9.2, ...). The release
# a version with no matching row just carries no quoted name.
